# goldendict-ng

**A desktop dictionary that looks words up in dictd and in Kiwix books**

- **Version recorded:** 25.06.0
- **Categories:** `references`
- **Upstream:** <https://github.com/xiaoyifang/goldendict-ng>

## What it does

A desktop look-up window: type a word, or select one in any application and press a shortcut, and it answers from every dictionary it knows -- the local dictd from `dictionaries`, StarDict and other dictionary files, and ZIM books such as a Wiktionary.

## Why you would want it

The desktop half of `dictionaries`: the same answers as `dict WORD` without a terminal, and one window for dictionaries and books together.

## Before it will work

A desktop session. Once `dictionaries` is installed, add the local dictd (127.0.0.1) as a DICT server among its dictionary sources, and add ZIM books by their folder. Where those settings sit in this version's menus has not been checked on a desktop here yet.

## Install and launch

- **Installed with the profile:** [`reference`](../profiles/reference.md).
- **Install:** `hammunition install goldendict-ng --dry-run`, read the plan, then run it without `--dry-run`.
- **Launch:** Its package ships its own commands and application-menu entry; a unit that ships none gets a generated terminal entry (**D-050**). `hammunition status` lists what is installed.
- **The install needs the network to:** your distribution's package archive.

## Offline use

*Not yet documented for this application.* Read “Before it will work” above for what it needs; the install-time network line above is the only offline fact generated from the manifest. Internet, a local network and a radio link are three different things, and this page does not claim any of them works until it says so.

## How it installs

- apt: `goldendict-ng`

## Known problems

It does not find dictd by itself: the DICT server has to be added once, by hand, as above. Qt6 WebEngine is a large dependency on a desktop without it.
